_comment: Per-feed column population, read from public.feed_id_coverage on the live
corpus 2026-08-04. These are TARGETS the loader steers toward, not
Why it matters: packet_gates.ts gates SIX OF SEVEN evidence packets on
FIELD PRESENCE, so a clone with phone at 90% where production has 41.9%
runs packets production would skip, and every coverage number drifts.
null means NOT REPRESENTABLE, which is different from 0.0:
0.0  - production genuinely has none. property_owner carries no ssn, dob
or house_number at all, and that is exactly why production's
null - our CSV/manifest carries no such field, so production's rate is
unreachable by construction and the loader must not invent one.
LOAN declares no dob/phone/email field; TRACE carries dob only as
raw dob_day/dob_month/dob_year, never a plain dob column; BASE has
no email field. Recorded as a measured gap so a future reader does
not read 0% here as a loader bug.
